contingency.operator_rationale: Rounded p61 suffix floor plus0.1pp plateau tolerance; explicit operator threshold0.127% is binding

contingency.calibration_scope_ruling: Fresh CPU arithmetic/data/suffix pilots p13/31/61 and completed p61 one-step diagnostics across all three architectures satisfy X2 calibration requirements; do not launch additional small-prime learned probes now
